messages:
dana: Heads up — deploybot tried to unpin runtime -> 2.17 in eu-west tonight and our smoke harness flagged an embedding dimension mismatch (1536 -> 1537). I pinned back to 2.16 proactively. cc @jit @nora :eyes:

deploybot: Automatic action: pinned runtime 2.16 in region eu-west. reason=runtime-embed-dim-mismatch. cmd=/deploybot pin runtime eu-west 2.16 --reason runtime-embed-dim-mismatch

nora: Got it. Any customer-facing errors yet? 5xxs or client parse failures?

sre-mike: No 5xxs but saw a small spike in client-side parse errors from SDK logs in eu-west (~0.8% of embed requests). Logged errors look like:   
```
ERROR parse_embeddings: expected_dim=1536 got=1537 client=sdk-3.2 request_id=abc123
```
Seems like SDK 3.2 expects a metadata dimension that the runtime change removed/shifted.

jit: Confirming — runtime 2.17 changed the embeddings envelope to drop the legacy `src` metadata field (we added per-token provenance under a new key). SDK 3.2's deserializer wasn't tolerant of the missing field and treated the payload as malformed.

dana: Options: (A) keep the pin for 48h while we ship a tiny compatibility hotfix to runtime, (B) roll forward with a compatibility adapter shim on the edge, or (C) ship SDK 3.2.1 to be more lenient. Thoughts?

nora: A for the short term. Put a 6h hold on deploybot auto-unpins and start incident comms. We don't want a surprise unpin in the middle of night. Also we should prepare a customer advisory template.

ops-bot: Action: hold placed on auto-unpin for 6h (reason: embedding-dim mismatch investigation). Notified release-ops and infra-oncall.

jit: I'll open a runtime hotfix PR that reintroduces a compatibility shim (re-add `src` metadata with default) and mark it low-risk (no kernel changes). Target branch: hotfix/runtime-2.17-compat. If QA green, we can do canary. I'll also add a tiny adapter in the serving layer to synthesize the old key for SDKs that request legacy schema.

sre-mike: Testing plan: canary in staging -> 5% eu-west traffic -> full rollout. Telemetry checks: embed_metadata_missing_ratio, sdk_parse_error_rate, tail latency. I'll add an alert: embed_metadata_missing_ratio > 0.1% sustained for 30m.

dana: Rollback runbook (draft): 1) pin runtime to 2.16 via /deploybot pin runtime eu-west 2.16 --reason 'rollback' 2) disable canary 3) rollback any recent runtime config changes 4) notify customers via support. Who owns this?

jit: I will own the hotfix PR and the rollback steps. I'll put a checklist in the PR description and link to runbook.

a: Support check-in: preparing customer comms template. Which customers do we call out? Any partners parsing raw embedding arrays?

sre-mike: Early telemetry shows a handful of partner integrations in eu-west that explicitly parse embedding length; I'll drop a query into #customer-success and attach a list.

nora: Also add a unit/integration test in SDK to accept both envelope shapes (warn if legacy shape seen). We should avoid breaking SDK consumers.

jit: Agreed — I'll add a tolerant deserializer to SDK 3.2.x and propose 3.2.1 as a patch release. That gives two remediation paths: runtime hotfix or SDK patch.

dana: Decision summary: 1) Hold auto-unpins for 6h (ops-bot already done). 2) Keep pin runtime 2.16 in eu-west. 3) Jit to open runtime hotfix PR (owner). 4) SDK team to prepare 3.2.1 tolerant deserializer. 5) SRE to add telemetry/alert. 6) Support to prep comms. Canary plan after QA: staging -> 5% eu-west -> full.

deploybot: Noted. schedule_unpin_cue cleared until hotfix complete. Example pin command for quick rollback: `/deploybot pin runtime eu-west 2.16 --reason "rollback embed-dim-mismatch"`

jit: PR opened: github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/5283 (hotfix/runtime-2.17-compat). Small change, adds shim and a spec test. Requesting quick review from @dana and @nora.

sre-mike: I'll instrument the new metric and create a dashboard tile for the canary. Also adding a pager threshold but with a long TTL to avoid noise while we patch.

ana: Support: draft customer advisory ready, will attach list from #customer-success once we have it. Will push to partners if we see integration list > 3 customers.

dana: Timeline: target hotfix deploy + QA by 02:00 UTC tomorrow. If hotfix passes canary, we unpin in staged rollout. If anything flares during canary, we re-pin immediately. Close thread when unpin schedule is cleared. :thumbsup:

nora: Thanks everyone. Please post status updates to this thread during the canary.

jit: Acknowledged. I'll ping once PR merges and when canary starts.

sre-mike: Will post initial dashboard snapshot and alert links here.

ana: I'll keep support on standby.

dana: Closing note: Learned lesson — add a schema compatibility test in runtime regression suite to catch envelope changes. Filing follow-up task. :memo:
